subject: Kickoff: do large LMs actually use retrieval? (ELI5 track)
body:
Team,

Kicking off the retrieval-LM effort. The research question from our open-source release stands: smaller language models demonstrably don't use retrieved text on ELI5, so does capacity change that? We pair GPT2-XL (1.5B params) with a REALM-style retriever on the KILT version of the ELI5 task and measure whether the model exploits retrieved contextual information.

Why it matters as product: factual consistency in generation is the blocker for putting generative text models in front of customers. If retrieval measurably grounds a larger model, that's the foundation for our grounded-answers offering.

Milestones (Apr 27 - Aug 17 window): retriever + LM harness reproduced by May 29, retrieval-ablation results by July 3, factual-consistency readout and go/no-go for productization by Aug 14.

Jelena owns staffing and compute. Quentin leads the modeling track.

Anders
